name: Spirit World: Celadon Faultlands
environment_theme: A dry Spirit World fault basin cut by exposed celadon ley veins. Pale mineral silt and charcoal basalt frame narrow jade-lit fissures; stone chips hover just above some seams, and clear water trickles uphill into still pools. Bronze survey markers and small way shrines stabilize routes. No bamboo forest, swamp, coast, mountain skyline, cloud island, or technological circuitry.
art_style: 2D orthographic straight-down map art; anime-painted gouache, dark #263A35 ink contours, broad readable value planes, material-led colors, restrained upper-left light.

variant_plans.prompt: Match the base jade seam cluster's camera, silhouette, footprint, and gouache finish. Show its harvest-depleted state: broken pale host stone, only small dull celadon fragments remaining, no bright exposed seam, same transparent framing and bottom contact. Do not add tools or a character.

Match the base veinroot bloom's silhouette, footprint, camera, and gouache finish. Show the same plant after harvesting: the luminous flower head is gone, with a clean short cut stem and a few intact celadon leaves remaining. Keep its original ground anchor and transparent framing; no tool, character, or detached loot.

Match the base bronze-and-stone pulse marker's silhouette, scale, camera, anchor, and gouache finish. Show its active state with one restrained celadon pulse visible in the central inset and a small contained glow on the ground directly beneath it. No large aura, text, runes, or added objects.

Match the intact linewalker bridge's camera, span, width, footprint, materials, and end anchors. Show moderate damage: one missing central slab and a cracked bronze brace, while both approaches remain recognizable. Keep damage inside the original footprint, transparent surroundings, and the same restrained gouache style.
